title: Skip _1d/_1h builder evaluation between bar closes, only for legs proven not to read the forming bar
note: Split out of TICK-BUILDER-TIMING by Manager 26a 2026-11-27 13:32Z: NOT caching, because builders may read the forming bar (forming catch-up, intrabar stops), so a skip can change signals. Step 1: list, per builder, whether it reads the last (forming) row: decision_bar forming vs closed, _fetch_session_frame users, intrabar stop logic. Step 2: only closed-bar-only legs qualify; they already skip via _closed_window_skip. Measured basis (19 ticks after the 12:58Z restart): 16 _1d legs 5.84 s/tick, 9 _1h legs 3.22 s/tick of builder time.
